ideas.name: Hedger Position Change Reversal
ideas.claim: Commodity futures bought most heavily by hedgers subsequently outperform those sold most heavily. The 26-commodity sample includes gold, silver, platinum and palladium; the reported portfolio result is not specific to metals.
ideas.quote: And commodities which are purchased by hedgers subsequently outperform those that are sold by them.
ideas.mechanism: Reversal associated with liquidity provision by hedgers following changes in commodity futures positions.

rules.market: 26 commodity futures, including gold, silver, platinum and palladium
rules.timeframe: Weekly position changes; 20 trading days after ranking
rules.entry: At the end of Tuesday, rank futures by the prior week's change in hedgers' net long positions; buy the top half and sell the bottom half in equally weighted portfolios.
rules.exit: Measure returns over the 20 trading days following the ranking.

ideas.claimed_result: The top-half minus bottom-half portfolio earned an average excess return of 43 basis points over 20 days. The paper reports that the Tuesday position data were published on the following Friday, so the first four days preceded public release.
required_data: Commodity futures prices across the 26-market universe
